prompt: Single continuous shot. Three ingredients in hard spotlight: a sardine tin, dry spaghetti, one lemon — one second still. Then motion: the tin cracked open, sardines sliding into sizzling garlic oil and breaking apart golden, pasta lifted dripping into the pan. Money shot: lemon zest grated in a bright flurry over the tossing strands, juice squeezed with droplets flying backlit, everything lifting glossy in macro. Final beat: the plate twirled high, toasted breadcrumbs raining over it. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the tin crack, then the sizzle. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Como prometido: a lata mais subestimada do armário. Sardinha + alho + limão vira um macarrão de trattoria — por menos de dez reais. **Sábado que vem: [A] pão amanhecido, leite e queijo ou [B] carne moída, cenoura e batata-doce? Comenta A ou B 👇**
